_comment: KV-EMA plus this block's Hebbian read at gain 1 (2026-10-17): read = q~ (sum_t v k~^T + alpha_h W)^T with W <- (1 - eta) W + eta sum_t v k~^T. Same as B-EMA except that the EMA integrates the Hebbian write instead of the STDP term Im S (no clock, no traces). eta learned per head from 0.0625, alpha_h learned from 1 as in B-EMA.
